I have cloned the official **`pret/pokeyellow`** disassembly (`https://github.com/pret/pokeyellow`), analyzed its Generation I battle menu architecture (`engine/battle/core.asm`, `engine/battle/draw_hud_pokeball_gfx.asm`, `data/text_boxes.asm`, and `data/moves/moves.asm`), recompiled the full 165-move database into `src/data/pokeyellow-data.js`, and implemented the authentic Pokémon Yellow battle menu system.

---

### 1. Analysis of `pret/pokeyellow` Battle Menus & HUDs
From the disassembly (`engine/battle/core.asm` & `data/text_boxes.asm`):
1. **`DrawHUDsAndHPBars` & `DrawAllPokeballs` (`engine/battle/core.asm:1886`, `engine/battle/draw_hud_pokeball_gfx.asm:1`)**:
   - **Enemy HUD (`(0, 0)..(11, 3)`)**: Displays the enemy Pokémon's name, `:L<level>` (replaced by 3-letter status `PAR`/`SLP`/`PSN`/`BRN`/`FRZ` when afflicted), 48px `HP:` bar inside the left-side L-bracket (`┃└────────◢`), and the 6-slot **Enemy Party Poké Ball indicator bar** (`●` healthy, dark `●` statused, `×` fainted, `·` empty) in trainer battles.
   - **Player HUD (`(9, 7)..(19, 11)`)**: Displays the active party Pokémon's back sprite (`*_BACK`), name, `:L<level>`/status, `HP:` bar, and right-aligned `curHP/maxHP` readout inside the right-side L-bracket (`◣────────┘┃`).
2. **`BATTLE_MENU_TEMPLATE` (`DisplayBattleMenu` at `engine/battle/core.asm:2076`, `data/text_boxes.asm:31`)**:
   - Overlays `(8, 12)..(19, 17)` on the right side of the bottom `MESSAGE_BOX` `(0, 12)..(19, 17)` with the 2×2 command grid (`FIGHT`, `<PK><MN>`, `ITEM`, `RUN`).
   - Navigating with the D-pad moves the `▶` cursor across the 2 columns and 2 rows; selecting `ITEM` turns the main menu cursor into a hollow arrow `▷` (`PlaceUnfilledArrowMenuCursor`, line 2219).
3. **`SAFARI_BATTLE_MENU_TEMPLATE` (`data/text_boxes.asm:32`)**:
   - Used for wild encounters in Safari Zone segments (`SAFARI_ZONE_*`), spanning `(0, 12)..(19, 17)` with `BALL×30`, `BAIT`, `THROW ROCK`, and `RUN`.
4. **`MoveSelectionMenu` & `PrintMenuItem` (`engine/battle/core.asm:2567–3085`)**:
   - Selecting `FIGHT` opens the 4-slot single-spaced **Move List Box** at `(4, 12)..(19, 17)` and the overlapping **`TYPE/` & `PP` Box** at `(0, 8)..(10, 12)` (`TYPE/`, `<MOVE_TYPE>`, `<curPP>/<maxPP>`).
   - Moving the cursor (`UP`/`DOWN` with wrap-around at lines 2801–2822) dynamically updates the move's type and PP readout; pressing `SELECT` swaps move order (`SwapMovesInMenu`, line 2926) using the `▷` marker.
5. **`DisplayBagMenu` (`LIST_MENU_BOX` at `(4, 2)..(19, 12)`, `engine/battle/core.asm:2329`)**:
   - Selecting `ITEM` overlays the scrollable bag menu (`POKé BALL`, `GREAT BALL`, `ULTRA BALL`, `MASTER BALL`, `POTION`, `SUPER POTION`, `FULL RESTORE`, `POKé FLUTE`, `CANCEL`) with item quantities (`×10`, etc.).
6. **`DisplayPartyMenu` & `SWITCH_STATS_CANCEL_MENU_TEMPLATE` (`engine/battle/core.asm:2405–2547`, `data/text_boxes.asm:33`)**:
   - Selecting `PKMN` opens the full-screen 6-slot party view with HP bars, status tags, and `"Choose a POKéMON."` prompt.
   - Selecting a party member opens the `SWITCH / STATS / CANCEL` submenu at `(11, 11)..(19, 17)`, where `SWITCH` swaps the active battler (updating its back sprite, HUD, and 4 moves) and `STATS` opens the Gen I `StatusScreen` (`ATK`, `DEF`, `SPD`, `SPC`, `TYPE/`, and Moves + PP).

---

### 2. Summary of Changes Implemented
- **`tools/build_pokeyellow_data.py` & `src/data/pokeyellow-data.js`**: Fixed the `moves.asm` parser and compiled all **165 Generation I moves** (with exact names from `data/moves/names.asm`, power, type, accuracy, PP, and effect) alongside the 151 Pokémon base stats/learnsets, 308 front/back Pokémon sprites, and 46 official Trainer sprites.
- **`src/engine.js`**: Added unpacking for `trainerSprites` (`POKEYELLOW_DATA.sprites.trainers`).
- **`index.html` & `src/styles.css`**: Built the authentic Generation I battle HUDs (with L-brackets and trainer party Poké Ball indicators) and all nested battle menu boxes (`MESSAGE_BOX`, `BATTLE_MENU_TEMPLATE`, `SAFARI_BATTLE_MENU_TEMPLATE`, `MoveSelectionMenu` + `PrintMenuItem` `TYPE/` & `PP` box, `LIST_MENU_BOX` Bag menu, and `DisplayPartyMenu` + `SWITCH/STATS/CANCEL` + `StatusScreen`).
- **`src/app.js`**: Implemented the full state machine (`MAIN_MENU`, `FIGHT_MENU`, `BAG_MENU`, `PARTY_MENU`, `PARTY_SUB`, `PARTY_STATS`, `MESSAGE`), Gen I damage/STAB/type-effectiveness/critical-hit/status calculations, multi-Pokémon trainer parties, and full D-Pad/keyboard (`WASD`/Arrows, `Z`/`Space`/`Enter` = A, `X`/`Backspace` = B, `Shift` = Select) and mouse/touch support.
